notes.title: Final weekend for the contest!
notes.notes:
Hello Atlanteans!

There's still some time to beat that amount of damage, or complete a faster run without health lost. We're curious to see how you fare!
Have a great weekend✨

- The Roofkat team

notes.title: Escaping Atlantis Contest: Dealing damage, not taking it
notes.notes:
Calling all Atlantean master tacticians!

Escaping Atlantis will be participating in Steam's Deckbuilder Fest starting next Monday, which means it will be the perfect time to try out our new demo.

For those up for an extra challenge, we have something exciting to share: We're running a contest!

The contest will take place while the Deckbuilders Fest is live, so from the 25th of March till the 31st.
We have two challenges, see more information below!

[url=https://discord.com/channels/474268106936811532/1221038635667816480][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061046/563a10108e0f85766cc05abae4a30c3bfc49d2a9.png[/img][/url]

There are two categories: Most damage done in one turn, and least health lost in a successful run.
You can participate in either categories or both!

Please follow these steps to join:
- In the options menu, press the "Toggle Contest Counters" to make sure the counters are visible.
- Please play the game without the tutorial, so press "New Game" "Yes" "No" to start your run.
- Take a screenshot of HD resolution (1920x1080) or better where the counters show what you want to submit.
- Post this screenshot in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/474268106936811532/1221038635667816480]#share-your-run channel on discord[/url].
- That's it*!

*If multiple people manage to complete a successful run without any health lost, the first one to submit their screenshot will be declared the winner of that category.

*In case there's any uncertainty about a submission (e.g. someone with some good photoshop skills) we'll ask to see a recording of your run, so If you are going to do something very impressive (successful run with 0 damage taken, or a huge amount of damage in one turn), please record your run and upload it unlisted on youtube, so we can verify it if needed.

We wish you best of luck and are excited to see how you do!

Cheers,
- The Roofkat Team

notes.title: Escaping Atlantis takes part in the Steam Deckbuilding Fest with a fresh Demo!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce a new updated demo of Escaping Atlantis in time for the Deckbuilder Fest!!

The demo will be playable all throughout the fest, which runs from March 25th to April 1st.

For those of you have played an earlier version of the game - we have made quite a few changes to the game: With dynamic backgrounds, rebalanced gameplay and a brand new tutorial. We would love to hear your feedback!

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue our escape!

Cheers,
The Roofkat Team

notes.title: Welcome to The Hub + Demo Is Still Live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061046/b7d3439547640437b4fbe4515d8d6194a5cf5333.png[/img]

[b]The demo is live for the weekend! [/b]
[i]Meet some quirky Atlanteans, outrun some gnarly waves, and defeat the (not-so)final boss! Try the demo while it's still up[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1260450/Escaping_Atlantis/

In the meantime, you can take a look at what we've been working on! Here's [i]'The Hub'[/i], which is the point between each run. Here you'll be able to look at previous run stats, scheck for upgrades, and prep for your next run.

The art side of things is finished, we've added some UI and animations for a bit more movement, and this week we're going to start implementing it into the game!

notes.title: Escaping Atlantis Will Feature in the Turn Based Carnival Along With A Demo
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We are excited to announce that we will be participating in the Turn Based Carnival! It will be organized from 14th November to 21st November and during this period the demo will be up for everyone to try.

We have shown the demo at a few live events recently and iterated based on that. We'd love to hear what you think about the latest version!

If you have any comments or suggestions for us, please feel free to add a response here or join us on Discord below:

https://discord.gg/CYuBXvh8nj 

And if you haven't yet, please consider wishlisting the Steam page, it helps us out a lot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1260450/Escaping_Atlantis/

Good luck Escaping Atlantis!

- The Roofkat team
